tldr_zh: OpenAI因安全隱憂暫停Astra模型、Meta遭罰逾5.6億美元治理青少年心理健康、科技公司加強AI安全管制成主軸。
tldr_en: OpenAI pauses Astra model over security concerns, Meta fined $567M for youth mental health, tech companies strengthen AI safety measures.

items.title_zh: OpenAI暫停Astra模型開發，因其具備獨立發起網路攻擊能力
items.title_en: OpenAI Pauses Astra Model Development Over Critical Cybersecurity Capabilities
items.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布暫停開發中的AI模型Astra的內部活動，因該模型已達到「關鍵網路安全閾值」，意即能夠獨立識別並對防禦良好的現實系統發動網路攻擊。此舉反映OpenAI在AI安全方面的謹慎態度，同時也是業界對AI能力邊界的重要探討。
items.summary_en: OpenAI announced it is pausing internal activities on its in-development AI model Astra, which has reached critical cybersecurity capabilities that could enable independent cyberattacks on well-protected systems. This reflects OpenAI's cautious approach to AI safety and industry-wide considerations about AI capability boundaries.

items.title_zh: Google開源天氣預報AI模型，熱帶氣旋預測提前逾24小時
items.title_en: Google Open-Sources WeatherNext AI Model with Improved Cyclone Forecasting
items.summary_zh: Google DeepMind開源WeatherNext天氣AI模型，研究刊登於《Nature》期刊。該模型在預測熱帶氣旋路徑、強度及風圈範圍時，相比現行主要氣象預報模型，可提前超過24小時達到相同準確度，展現AI在氣象預報的實際應用價值。
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind released WeatherNext weather AI models with research published in Nature. The model can predict tropical cyclone paths and intensity with 24+ hours advance over current forecasting methods at equivalent accuracy, demonstrating AI's practical value in weather prediction.

items.title_zh: Oracle禁止OpenJDK使用AI生成程式碼，強化開源專案品質控制
items.title_en: Oracle Bans AI-Generated Code from OpenJDK
items.summary_zh: Oracle針對開源Java開發工具包OpenJDK實施禁令，不允許提交AI生成的程式碼。此舉反映業界對AI生成程式碼品質、可靠性及智慧財產權的擔憂，標誌著開源社群對AI工具的謹慎態度。
items.summary_en: Oracle has banned AI-generated code submissions to OpenJDK, reflecting industry concerns about code quality, reliability, and intellectual property issues. This marks a cautious stance toward AI coding tools in the open-source community.

items.title_zh: Cloudflare推出WebMCP開發者預覽，AI代理可直接操作網站功能
items.title_en: Cloudflare Launches WebMCP for AI Agent Integration with Websites
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare推出WebMCP開發者預覽版，網站管理者無需修改程式碼即可在Cloudflare控制臺啟用此功能。啟用後，系統會自動為網頁加入橋接程式，使AI代理能發現和直接調用網站提供的功能，大幅簡化AI與網站的整合流程。
items.summary_en: Cloudflare launched WebMCP developer preview, allowing websites to enable AI agent integration without code changes. The system automatically injects bridge code enabling AI agents to discover and directly call website functions, simplifying AI-website integration.

items.title_zh: Meta遭新墨西哥法院判罰5.67億美元，需資助青少年心理健康治療
items.title_en: Judge Rules Meta Must Pay $567M for Youth Mental Health Crisis
items.summary_zh: 新墨西哥州法院裁定Meta造成「公共滋擾」，下令Meta支付5.67億美元用於治療其協助造成的青少年心理健康危機。此舉為首次有法院以「公共滋擾」名義判罰科技公司承擔社會責任，標誌著對平臺責任的司法認定。
items.summary_en: A New Mexico court ruled Meta caused a 'public nuisance' and ordered $567M in funding for youth mental health treatment. This marks the first court judgment holding a tech platform accountable for social harm through public nuisance doctrine.

items.title_zh: 微軟Edge瀏覽器終止Manifest V2支持，ad blockers面臨淘汰
items.title_en: Microsoft Edge Ending Manifest V2 Extension Support
items.summary_zh: 微軟Edge宣布終止對Manifest V2擴展平臺的支持，這將導致uBlock Origin等ad blocker失效，追隨Google Chrome的做法。Edge上僅58個MV2擴展有顯著使用量，其中僅3個廣泛應用的ad blocker面臨失效。
items.summary_en: Microsoft Edge is ending support for Manifest V2 extensions, disabling ad blockers like uBlock Origin, following Google Chrome. Only 3 widely-used ad blockers among the 58 MV2 extensions will be affected.

items.title_zh: Gitea爆發CVSS 9.8重大漏洞，攻擊者無需登入可遠程執行程式碼
items.title_en: Gitea Patches Critical CVE-2026-59774 Code Execution Vulnerability
items.summary_zh: 開源Git服務平臺Gitea揭露CVE-2026-59774漏洞，攻擊者無需登入帳號，僅需利用文件處理功能即可讀取伺服器內部檔案及取得存取令牌，進而在系統上執行任意程式碼。漏洞評分達9.8分，官方已在1.27.1版本修補。
items.summary_en: Gitea patched critical CVE-2026-59774 (CVSS 9.8) allowing unauthenticated remote code execution. Attackers can exploit file handling features to read internal files, obtain access tokens, and execute arbitrary code. Fixed in version 1.27.1.

items.title_zh: Claude分享對話可被Google搜尋，恐致用戶敏感資訊曝光
items.title_en: Anthropic's Claude Shared Conversations Indexable by Google Search
items.summary_zh: 資安業者Malwarebytes發現Anthropic AI聊天工具Claude的分享對話可被Google搜尋引擎索引，導致用戶敏感資訊可能意外曝光。此問題最初由Reddit用戶發現，反映分享功能的隱私設計缺陷。
items.summary_en: Security researchers at Malwarebytes found that Claude shared conversations can be indexed by Google Search, exposing user sensitive information. The issue, first discovered by Reddit users, reveals privacy design flaws in the sharing feature.

items.title_zh: 中國Zbtlink路由器內建後門，至少20款產品遭遠端接管
items.title_en: Chinese Zbtlink Routers Found with Built-in Backdoors Affecting 20+ Models
items.summary_zh: 資安業者VulnCheck研究指出，中國路由器品牌Zbtlink至少20款產品的韌體內建後門，開機後會主動連線遠端伺服器並執行任意指令。由於連線未驗證伺服器身分，駭客可劫持連線冒充原廠接管路由器。
items.summary_en: Security researchers at VulnCheck discovered that at least 20 Zbtlink router models contain built-in backdoors connecting to remote servers with highest privileges. Lack of server authentication allows attackers to hijack connections and take control.

items.title_zh: 伊朗疑似攻擊美國水利系統，前NSA官員呼籲離線管理
items.title_en: Ex-NSA Chief Warns Water Controllers Shouldn't Be Online After Suspected Iran Attacks
items.summary_zh: 美國前NSA官員警告，關鍵水利系統控制器不應連接網際網路。此警告出現在伊朗疑似攻擊美國水利設施之後，凸顯基礎設施網路安全的重要性，強調應採用離線管理方式保護關鍵系統。
items.summary_en: An ex-NSA chief warned that water system controllers should not be connected to the internet, following suspected Iranian attacks on US water infrastructure. This highlights critical infrastructure cybersecurity concerns and advocates for offline management of essential systems.

items.title_zh: Nvidia Dynamo修補CVSS 9.8重大漏洞，AI推論框架存在越界寫入風險
items.title_en: Nvidia Dynamo Patches Critical Buffer Overflow in AI Inference Framework
items.summary_zh: Nvidia發布軟體更新修補分散式AI推論框架Dynamo的多項漏洞，包括CVSS 9.8的CVE-2026-24254越界寫入漏洞，以及2項CVSS 8.2漏洞。此更新針對Linux版本Dynamo發布，涉及關鍵AI基礎設施安全。
items.summary_en: Nvidia patched multiple vulnerabilities in Dynamo AI inference framework, including critical CVE-2026-24254 (CVSS 9.8) buffer overflow and two CVSS 8.2 vulnerabilities. Updates released for Linux version affecting critical AI infrastructure security.

items.title_zh: 土耳其與沙烏地、巴基斯坦簽防禦協定，澄清無針對伊朗
items.title_en: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan Sign Joint Defense Pact Amid Middle East Tensions
items.summary_zh: 土耳其與沙烏地阿拉伯及巴基斯坦簽署共同防禦協定，任何一國遭攻擊視同對三國的攻擊。土耳其澄清此協定並非針對特定國家，但在美伊衝突升溫背景下，此舉彰顯中東戰略聯盟的重組。
items.summary_en: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan signed a joint defense pact declaring an attack on any member as an attack on all. Turkey clarified it targets no specific nation, but the move reflects Middle East strategic realignment amid US-Iran tensions.

items.title_zh: 泰國14歲少年槍殺8人後自殺，總理誓言加強槍枝管制
items.title_en: Thai Teen Kills 8 in School Shooting, PM Vows Stricter Gun Laws
items.summary_zh: 泰國發生校園槍擊案，一名14歲少年在家中及學校開槍殺害8人後自殺，其中5名死者為教師。泰國總理承諾推動更嚴格的槍枝管制法，回應此一重大安全事件。
items.summary_en: A 14-year-old opened fire at his home and school in Thailand, killing 8 people including 5 teachers before shooting himself. The Thai PM vowed to introduce stricter gun laws following the tragedy.

items.title_zh: 西班牙因摩洛哥移民潮對義大利實施邊境管制，北非移民問題升溫
items.title_en: Spain Imposes Border Controls on Italy Over Migrant Crisis from Morocco
items.summary_zh: 因摩洛哥約7.8萬移民湧入西班牙飛地休達，義大利隨後實施邊境管制。西班牙則反制實施對義大利的邊境管制，反映歐洲各國對北非移民潮的分歧應對。
items.summary_en: Spain imposed border controls on Italy in response to Italy's restrictions following an influx of 78,000 migrants from Morocco into Spanish enclave Ceuta. The escalating measures reflect European discord on handling African migration.
